progress_proof.outer_proof: Each outer returns4096 positive bytes unless it reaches EOF, in which case that pipe can return one final short positive result. Every retained positive result creates exactly one next outer request; two initial requests. For p=0..2 EOF-short positive pipes, retained full chunks <=floor((1048576-p)/4096), hence at most257 retained positives and259 total invocations. Cap/write/stage failures stop requeueing. Final zero/fault results do not create another request.
progress_proof.inner_1056772_proof: Each positive inner ReadAsync result advances its current outer total by at least one byte and never beyond that outer4096-byte buffer. All completed-and-written outer data is <=1MiB; at most two other current/unretained outer buffers contribute<=8192 bytes. Per pipe a zero result can occur once to terminate an EOF-short positive outer and once in its final requeued zero/fault outer; a fault also terminates that pipe chain. Thus at most four nonprogress terminal calls, and I<=1048576+8192+4=1056772. This counts calls, not a guaranteed kernel-read count or time bound.
progress_proof.quarantine: Only one outstanding outer per pipe; the outer awaits inner calls sequentially. Callback registration disposal precedes its InvokeAsync completion. An unsettled child owns process/read tasks/two buffers/log streams/CTS in quarantine; the next-child gate refuses. Clearing arrays, disposing, nulling references or scope exit grants no physical-free credit.
